title: Velocity-Loss Accumulation by Set
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), sprint reps (`sprint:rep`), serve attempts (`serve:attempt`), pickleball rallies (`pickleball:rally`), swim sets (`swim:set`), archery ends (`archery:end`), balance trials (`balance:trial`), and batting reps (`batting:rep`).
app: Sports and skill telemetry from VBT devices, sprint timers, serve trackers, swim logs, archery apps, balance trainers, and batting sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vbt:rep
| stats max(bar_speed_mps) as fastest_mps min(bar_speed_mps) as slowest_mps by exercise set_id
| eval velocity_loss_pct=round(100*(fastest_mps-slowest_mps)/fastest_mps,1)
| sort - velocity_loss_pct
description: Calculates percent velocity loss within each set so fatigue thresholds are easier to coach and review.
value: Velocity loss is a practical readiness and fatigue metric, especially when you want more than just weight and reps on the page.
implementation: Export rep-by-rep bar speed from your VBT device and group it by exercise and set identifier.
visualization: Bar chart of velocity-loss percentage by set.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how much bar speed falls off during each set, which helps show when fatigue is building.
